# WY PMC 'Whiteshields'
## Under Construction This page is still being written. Until then, here is the unit's lore primer.
[italic]The Weyland-Yutani Private Military Company (WEYU PMC), known as the 'Whiteshields', is the organized security force of Weyland-Yutani. While usually reserved for operations directly related to Weyland-Yutani facilities, whether for security or containment, colonial governments have often found hiring them to be more efficient and effective than relying on the local military.[/italic]
